email_subject: Application - Junior Marketing & Employer Branding Officer
email_body:
Dear NORRIQ Financial Services team,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Marketing & Employer Branding Officer position. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in SEO, content creation, and social media, I am excited about the opportunity to help build NORRIQ's brand and attract top talent.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites, which has sharpened my ability to create engaging, on-brand content. My personal project, mirook.com, demonstrates my proactive approach: I designed and built the site, implemented structured data, and optimized it for both traditional and AI-powered search engines. I am comfortable with analytics tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush, and I am eager to expand my skills in marketing automation and CRM systems.

I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a B1 level in Dutch and actively improving. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and I am enthusiastic about joining a fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment where I can contribute creatively and grow professionally.

I would love to discuss how I can help NORRIQ Financial Services stand out. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
